product.olivetti-m380-xp3.summary: The desktop configuration announced in April 1988 with 2 MB of RAM and a 135 MB disk.
product.olivetti-m380-xp3.history: The documentation places M380/XP3 as the desktop configuration announced in April 1988 with 2 MB of RAM and a 135 MB disk.
product.olivetti-m380-xp3.architecture: Memory organisation determines expansion options. The guide identifies BA814. All RAM resides on expansion boards.
product.olivetti-m380-xp3.firmware: The BIOS revision helps identify the service configuration. The guide records 2.0 · PBZ6/PBZ7.
product.olivetti-m380-xp3.verified: The identity was checked in Olivetti documentation. The sheet remains under research.
product.olivetti-m380-xp3.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-m380-xp3.guide: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, 8-1–8-2.
product.olivetti-m380-xp3.press: Computerwoche, 29.04.1988, Olivetti bringt 80386er auf den Markt.
